newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM Corp to issue 1 bln-peso preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: RFM Corp to issue 1 bln-peso preferred shrs.

text.p: Food company RFM Corp said on Wednesday its board of directors approved the issuance of one billion pesos worth of convertible preferred shares by year-end.
RFM president Jose Concepcion said in a statement the issuance will finance its 3.0 billion peso expansion and diversification program.
The shares will carry a coupon rate of 8 to 10 percent and will be sold on a pre-emptive basis to existing shareholders of RFM's common shares.
Issue price will be at the stock market price of the common shares at the time of the issue. The preferred shares will have a term of five years.
The company did not say when the issue would be offered.
